_readme: S739 wave B, the gap census's Next wave (census of 2026-11-26 06:54Z, run 45771011713; levers reader_page_assignment and paid_read): 1 program of San Diego City College whose filed record places none of the state's listed courses and whose title the catalog's list of degree curricula and certificate programs (15604/15945, 224 entries; college-page-read run 45782712226) does not print. The college's other program on the lever, Cosmetology 22367, has its own entry (15945/15788), which prints its four courses and 'Total Units: 24.0'; its filed record (run 38252422845) holds no course block, and it waits on a forced read behind a fresh capture. Filed as named gaps and never sent to a paid read. Each filed record stays as filed (the load skips a record that places none of its listed courses). No model call, no Supabase write. Each is the college's to settle in COCI or its catalog.
